s.t: A Sputnik Music review of Don't Stop or We'll Die's EP One of the Gang singles out ‘Once in Awhile’ as a send-up of the frustrated young trophy wife.
s.src: Sputnik Music review of One of the Gang
s.q: the songs are mainly send-ups of narrative tropes: the frustrated young trophy wife (“Once in Awhile”)

f.t: The band's songwriters, Paul Rust and Michael Cassady, also write songs for the Netflix series LOVE.
f.src: Don't Stop Or We'll Die official site

f.t: Sputnik Music described them as Los Angeles comedians Paul Rust, Harris Wittels and Mike Cassady writing silly piano-pop tunes from the point of view of odd characters.
f.src: Sputnik Music review of One of the Gang
f.q: DSOWD is made up of LA comedians Paul Rust, Harris Wittels, and Mike Cassady

f.t: Alongside its two songwriters, the band's lineup has included Tony Thaxton of Motion City Soundtrack and Emeen Zarookian, whose credits include The Monkees Farewell Tour and Spirit Kid.
f.src: Don't Stop Or We'll Die official site
f.q: along with musicians Tony Thaxton (Motion City Soundtrack) and Emeen Zarookian (The Monkees Farewell Tour, Spirit Kid)
